name: Loopkins
description: Loopkins is a 10,000-piece collection of looping PFP creatures. Each Loopkin is stacked from six APNG layers — sky, aura, body, face, wear, and charm — then flattened onto one 12-frame GIF. Skies pulse. Auras breathe. Faces blink. Charms orbit. One shared clock. Minting on Robinhood Chain.
